integrity: Self-contained human-readable derivation plus standalone supplementary checker; finite tests are not the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two quartic-coset unions at primes congruent to 5 modulo 8; no unrestricted half-band optimum or unproved infinitude claim. Classical Gauss and Jacobi sums are cited as inputs. Full historical cyclotomic priority is not independently certified.
title: Sharp adjacent-coset half-band Fourier projections on primes congruent to five modulo eight
